system.description:
Trained for the battlefield rather than the tower, a product of Arneyan's wartime economy.

  • Reshapes: your area spells.
  • Battlefield Composure: you are trained in light armour, so wearing it does not block your casting. Your area spells can exclude one ally of your choice inside the area.
    • 9th level: your area spells can exclude two allies. From 15th level these are on top of the creatures Sculpt Spells leaves out.
  • Tactical Eye: Advantage on checks to judge troop movements and battlefield tactics.
